d:
We had the utmost honour of re-watching the classic DDLJ. We set out to find how a film can play for 1000 weeks straight in theatres, and uncovered hidden treasures and creepiness.
Featuring a very special guest.
This review was done based on your suggestions! If you'd like us to review any other movies let us know in the comments.
As always, we'd like to know what you think. So tell us! (nicely).
